changes: Added a Hide button to the notch hover panel. It hides the notch like the Show floating bar switch in Settings, which now stays in sync, and Push-to-Talk brings it back.
The Rewind timeline now draws apps in soft pastel colors that blend into each other instead of switching hard from one color to the next
The Rewind timeline can now zoom in six times further, down to ten seconds across the bar, with second-by-second tick labels

Settings → General gains a Transparency slider under Font Size that sets how much of the desktop shows through the app's glass; every panel follows the thumb while you drag, the value persists across launches, and the system Reduce Transparency setting still forces solid panels

Rewind's screenshot no longer wears the app-coloured outline, and every control that used to sit on the picture — the date pill, the previous/next app buttons and the zoom buttons — moved into one row directly beneath it, with the app buttons centred as simple glass circles
Shortened the dashboard search placeholders: Search chat, Search activity, Search conversations, Search memories, Search rewind, and Search brain

Added a draggable scrubber to conversation audio playback; clicking any transcript bubble jumps the audio to that sentence and starts playing; the transcript header's refresh button re-fetches the transcript and re-syncs it to the audio on this Mac, so playback starts at 0:00 and bubbles line up with what is heard
Fixed voice typing losing a dictation in browsers and Electron apps, where it reported "Insertion unconfirmed" instead of typing the text
